text:
Sam: quick huddle  post-launch prioritization. we have a regression causing occasional failed streaming for Dedicated customers and a small UX throughput indicator request from Sales. do we push both into the hotpatch or split?
Irene: regression is priority. impact: ~0.15% of streams fail end-to-end, but those are high-value customers and it's triggering SLA credit conversations. we should include the fix.
Devon: UX throughput indicator is low effort (frontend tick + lightweight telemetry) but it does touch the metrics pipeline and will need one extra smoke cycle.
Priya: QE window for a hotpatch this week is 36hrs. if we include both we may not finish customer-specific replay tests for Dedicated. those replays are required to validate the regression fix.
Sam: can the indicator be behind a customer-toggle or internal-only in canary? that would reduce QA surface.
Irene: yes, we can ship the indicator behind a toggle. but two caveats: Sales wants it visible for demos next week, and toggling per-customer requires an onboarding step.
Devon: technically doable: default off, enable for Sales orgs only via rollout config. no schema changes. QE effort for the flag is small.
Priya: for the regression, we need end-to-end replays for 3 Dedicated tenants. estimate 24hrs QE plus canary monitoring. combining both would compress time. I'm leaning split: regression in hotpatch, indicator in mini-wave behind flag.
Sam: ops question: how risky is the regression fix? any infra migrations?
Irene: it's a codepath bug in the streaming multiplexer; low-risk change but requires a brief cache invalidation during deploy. rollback is simple: revert multiplexer binary.
Devon: if we ship indicator flagged, we should avoid adding extra telemetry to the hotpatch pipeline to keep ingest simple. flag should be client-side with internal-only opt-in.
cs-bot: note: there is an opened CS ticket (#3245) requesting expedited notice to BigCorp about streaming failures; recommended customer comms draft pending.
Sam: decision proposal: hotpatch = streaming regression fix + targeted replay validation for 3 Dedicated tenants. mini-wave = throughput indicator behind Sales-only flag, with full roll after mini-wave QA. pre-canary checklist: replay results, regression minitest green, rollback script for multiplexer.
Irene: owners: Irene -> regression PR + replay fixtures, Priya -> QE plan + replay runs, Devon -> indicator flag PR and Sales rollout config, Sam -> release notes + CS comms.
Priya: rollback criteria: abort and revert if dedicated customer error-rate for streaming > 0.2% or 95th percentile stream tail latency increases > 20% during canary. will add automated gating.
Devon: timeline: I can land the flagged indicator branch by Tue EOD. no extra backend changes. need 30m review from Irene.
Irene: I can review Tue 09:00. regression PR ready Mon EOD, replay runs Tue morning.
cs-bot: reminder: pre-canary sync scheduled tomorrow 08:30 UTC.
Sam: OK. final summary: include regression in hotpatch to address Dedicated SLA risk; defer indicator to mini-wave behind Sales-only flag. owners and rollback criteria noted.
Devon: :thumbsup: will prep flag docs.
Priya: QE will schedule replays and smoke tests.
Irene: prepping deploy notes and rollback commands.
Sam: thanks team  ping me if anything blocks tonight. otherwise meet pre-canary 08:30 UTC.
